//: Shepherdr's add-ons (3.0.0, everything is a plugin): each feature, what it is made of and what it needs.
core is always installed and always on. Every add-on is installed too (one layout gives everything);
one with "switch": true can be turned off in Shepherdr settings > Window. The off list is shared
An add-on without a switch is always on in 3.1.9: splitting it from the panels it lives in comes later.
mods: folders under mods/. blocks: layout node ids it fills. keys: "<context> <key>" in keys.json. web: the web app's plugins (web/plugins), left out while it is off.
helpers: links put in ~/.local/bin. templates: ~/.config/herdr-core/templates. needs: other add-ons.

core.title: Core
core.about: The Shepherdr layout: sidebar, tab bar, chat pane header, status bar, toasts, menus, dialogs and these settings.

addons.title: Tasks
addons.about: The Tasks panel, the Accept card and herdr-task: every task with its own agent, worktree, review and merge.

addons.title: Assistants
addons.about: A coordinator for every space that turns what you write into tasks, and tells you their news.

addons.title: Chat
addons.about: Agents as a chat, with cards, attachments, model choice and opened images.

addons.title: Questions and permissions
addons.about: An agent's question or permission prompt comes to the chat as a card (Claude Code and Codex hooks).

addons.title: Secrets
addons.about: Agents ask for a key by name; you type it into a masked card and it goes straight to a private vault.

addons.title: Artifacts
addons.about: Reports and draft screens from agents, beside the chat, with markup. Off: no Artifacts panel button.

addons.title: Voice and dictation
addons.about: Call an Assistant and talk (an ElevenLabs key), and dictate into the box (the same key). Off: no call or mic buttons.

addons.title: Reactions
addons.about: React to an agent's message with an emoji. Off: no smiley button (agents' own reactions still show).

addons.title: Task browser
addons.about: Each task gets its own browser you can watch and take over. Off: no Browser tab, and workers aren't given one.

addons.title: Autopilot
addons.about: An Assistant works on its own between your messages, from its heartbeat. Off: no Autopilot switch, and no wake-ups.

addons.title: Other machines
addons.about: Keeps herdr-task, its helpers and the role templates the same on every connected machine. Off: nothing is sent.

addons.title: Web
addons.about: Shepherdr in your browser on phone, tablet and desktop, private to your tailnet. Off: the web app stops; the service keeps working.
